newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European vegetable oils ease on stronger dollar.
newsitem.headline: European vegetable oils ease on stronger dollar.

text.p: The European vegetable oils market closed with prices slightly lower on Monday on a stronger dollar with business restricted due to the UK bank holiday, traders said.
Soyoil remained strong in anticipation of a higher Chicago opening on a tight supply outlook in the U.S. but found little demand with only Nov/Jan traded at 108 guilders per 100 kg.
Crude palmoil traded at $567.50 a tonne, June at $565 and Jly/Sept at $560 a tonne cif. Some business was also reported in cocnut oil and RBD palmoil and olein.--Rotterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5832
